TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query

TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: PO_NBR = PO_NBR_in AND FACILITY_ID = FACILITY_ID_in AND ORDR_DTL_ID < ORDR_DTL_ID_in

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT CPA_ORDR_DTL.ORDER_STATUS as ORDER_STATUS, CPA_ORDR_DTL.FACILITY_ID as FACILITY_ID, CPA_ORDR_DTL.PO_NUMBER as PO_NUMBER, CPA_ORDR_DTL.CSOS_ID as CSOS_ID FROM CSOS.CPA_ORDR_DTL

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Update Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: UPDATE CSOS.CPA_ORDR_DTL SET ORDER_STATUS = :TU.ORDER_STATUS, UPD_BY = :TU.UPD_BY, UPD_TM = :TU.UPD_TM, SYNC_STATUS = :TU.SYNC_STATUS WHERE PO_NUMBER = :TU.PO_NUMBER AND FACILITY_ID = :TU.FACILITY_ID AND CSOS_ID = :TU.CSOS_ID
